warnings: Le tablier du Pont Vialleton est référencé par un axe IGN BD TOPO de précision altimétrique 1,5 m ; le profil de voûte provient de l’inventaire municipal et ne constitue pas une coque mesurée.
Les altitudes photogrammétriques de la voie basse ne donnent pas un sol fiable sous la partie couverte ; les cotes externes et le relief local restent des références distinctes.

provenance.purpose: Exact Pont Vialleton footprint, crossing roads, upper/lower approaches and retaining walls. Regression of the underpass ground and source deck height independently of arch profile. No neighbouring buildings.
provenance.roadAltitudeCaution: The lower road is one photogrammetric axis spanning the hidden underpass. Its Z47.6m at the south bridge edge disagrees with the RGE ALTI grid Z44.18m there and cannot define the under-arch ground confidently. Its south exterior Z44.0m and north exterior Z45.1m are outside the bridge. Precision Z1.5m. No OSM maxheight tags.

terrain.note: Exact cropped cells, at least one grid spacing beyond every retained coordinate. minElev preserves full Peyrou project IGN69 datum; bbox and scale preserve the original 300mm projection.

provenance.municipalWidthCaution: The municipal magazine describes the entire current bridge as 29.82m wide after historical widening. The scalar 8m inventory bridge_width does not represent the complete mapped north-south extent and is kept only as the original source attribute.
